items.title: 73243_Joe Thomas oral history interview
items.q: I left Teddy and went to Barney. One of the most pleasant experiences I ever had working with the guys.

ctx.x: I don't know but we had a nice little deal down there for maybe three or four months and we came on back and did three or four months again.
Yeah, he's got that here. Then he's got you in with Barney Bigard at the Onyx.
Oh, that's a jump really. No, I left Teddy and went to Barney. One of the most pleasant experiences I ever had working with the guys.
